about.heading: About Myself
about.text:
I'm a computer science student at Essex County College working across wearable robotics, embedded AI, and human sensing. I built an untethered situational awareness system for a wearable exoskeleton, running real-time hazard detection on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, and deployed it in a 6-participant study. As an undergraduate research assistant at NJIT's AnyMotion Lab, I collected synchronized human-motion data from 20 participants.

I work in Python, C++, Java, and Unity, with hands-on experience in motion capture, EMG, IMUs, and eye tracking. Right now I'm developing an eye-tracking VR training simulation of the Leica BLK2GO 3D scanner, which an NJIT professor has adopted for a civil engineering course.

items.title: Leica BLK2GO VR Training Simulation
items.description: An eye-tracking VR simulation of the Leica BLK2GO 3D scanner that bridges classroom and field training, adopted by an NJIT civil engineering course.
items.details:
An eye-tracking VR simulation of the Leica BLK2GO 3D scanner. Trainees follow the real scanning workflow, from capture to a **.PLY point cloud**.

**Adopted by an NJIT civil engineering course.**

items.title: Exoskeleton Situational Awareness System
items.description: A fully untethered safety system for a wearable exoskeleton, with real-time hazard detection, posture tracking, and haptic and audio alerts.
items.details: A fully untethered safety system for a wearable exoskeleton: **YOLOv11 hazard detection** and **IMU posture tracking** on a Jetson Orin Nano, with haptic and audio alerts. Deployed in a **6-participant** situational awareness study.

items.title: AnyMotion Lab, NJIT
items.description: Undergraduate research assistant collecting synchronized human-motion data with EMG sensors, IMUs, pressure insoles, and motion capture.
items.details: Instrumented participants with **6 EMG sensors, 10 IMUs, 2 pressure insoles and 28 motion-capture markers**, collected synchronized motion data from **20 participants**, and processed the captures for analysis.
